indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
The money transfer beneficiary lists a phone number or email address associated with a
pharmaceutical company or chemical sales website.
indicators.red_flag: Beneficiary identifier tied to chemical/pharma site
indicators.rationale: Gap; C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) needs D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data) enrichment.

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
U.S. remitter sends low-dollar money transfers to an individual in China for no apparent
legitimate purpose.  Individual transfers may range from $10 to $100, with an aggregated
amount of multiple transfers totaling approximately $600.
indicators.red_flag: Low-dollar no-purpose remittances to China supplier
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Conversely, a U.S. remitter sends a
high volume of money transfers to apparently unrelated individuals.
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Multiple U.S. remitters send money transfers to the same individual beneficiary in China (i.e.,
many to one).
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Seemingly unrelated beneficiaries share the same phone number or email address to receive
transactions.
indicators.rationale: Gap; C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) needs D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data) enrichment.

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
The volume of outgoing money transfers is not consistent with the expected activity of a U.S.
remitter.
indicators.red_flag: Outgoing transfer volume off customer profile
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
A U.S. remitter adjusts the money transfer amount to avoid BSA reporting and recordkeeping
requirements (i.e., structuring).
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag: Remitter uses multiple agent locations.
indicators.red_flag: Structuring across multiple MSB agent locations
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Remitter sends money transfers to the same beneficiary consecutively, instead of

aggregated in a single sum.
indicators.red_flag: Consecutive split transfers to same beneficiary
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.section: MSBs:  Money Transfer Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Two or more seemingly unrelated remitters are linked together by shared attributes such as
common addresses or profile information.  These remitters then coordinate transactions to
evade the recordkeeping threshold.
indicators.rationale: Gap; C15 (Beneficial-ownership, shell / front-company & nominee network analysis) needs D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data) enrichment.

indicators.section: Depository Institutions:  Structuring and Funnel Account Activity Red Flags
indicators.flag:
Account owners or third parties structure cash deposits at bank branches nationwide into the
same account, which funds outgoing transactions on the SWB, including cash withdrawals or
wire transfers to Mexico (i.e., funnel account activity and rapid movement of funds).
indicators.red_flag: Nationwide cash deposits, funnel account to Mexico
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: Depository Institutions:  Structuring and Funnel Account Activity Red Flags
indicators.flag:
The depository institutions have a suspicion concerning the physical condition of deposited
banknotes (e.g., the bills smell of drugs, detergent, or are excessively worn).
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2 (Cash & instrument channel data (ATM/ABM, teller, money orders, prepaid)).

indicators.section: Depository Institutions:  Structuring and Funnel Account Activity Red Flags
indicators.flag: The source of funds cannot be corroborated.
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C8 (Income / occupation-vs-activity profile-inconsistency detection) on D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate
